passages.title: The Lamp Seller
passages.text:
At dusk the old man lights his lamps,
One hundred small and trembling flames,
And sets them on the market stone
Beside the sellers' shouting names.
The buyers hurry through the cold;
They count their coins and do not look.
But he, with patient, wrinkled hands,
Reads light as other men read a book.
Some say he is a foolish man
Who loses oil and gains no pay;
Yet those who pass his small bright flame
Remember it for many a day.
When night grows deep and stalls are closed,
He walks away, his work half done,
And leaves one burning on the stone
For strangers walking home alone.

passages.title: Libraries Must Not Fall Silent
passages.text: Across many small towns, public libraries are being closed or reduced to a single dusty room with a part-time clerk. Officials justify this by saying that everything is now available on the internet. This argument is both lazy and misleading. A phone can give a child an answer; a library gives her a habit. The quiet table, the librarian's recommendation and the chance discovery of a book one never intended to read cannot be downloaded. Moreover, millions of families still lack reliable connectivity or devices, and for them the library is the only door to knowledge. Rather than shutting these institutions, authorities should extend their hours, stock them with books in local languages and link them with schools. The cost of such a step is modest; the cost of neglect, measured in lost curiosity, will be paid for decades. A town without a library is not saving money. It is merely postponing a larger bill.

passages.title: How Bats Find Their Way in the Dark
passages.text: Bats are not blind, but many of them hunt in complete darkness by using echolocation. A bat sends out high-pitched sounds, usually too high for human ears to hear, through its mouth or nose. These sound waves travel outward until they strike an object, such as a flying moth, and bounce back as echoes. The bat's large ears catch the echoes, and its brain compares them with the original call. The time taken by the echo to return tells the bat how far the object is, while changes in the pitch reveal whether the object is moving towards or away from it. Some bats can detect a wire thinner than a human hair. As the bat comes closer to its prey, it increases the number of calls per second, producing a rapid buzz that gives more precise information for the final capture. Scientists study this system closely because similar principles are used in sonar and in devices that help visually impaired people.

questions.question: In the sentence "I know that she is honest", the clause "that she is honest" is a ___ clause.
questions.explanation: "That she is honest" is the object of the verb "know", so it works like a noun: it is a noun clause. It does not modify a verb (adverb clause), does not follow a noun to describe it (relative clause), and cannot stand alone as the main clause.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a non-defining relative clause with correct punctuation?
options: My brother who lives in Delhi, is a doctor.
My brother, who lives in Delhi is a doctor.
My brother, who lives in Delhi, is a doctor.
My brother who lives in Delhi is, a doctor.
questions.explanation: A non-defining clause adds extra information and is set off by a pair of commas, before and after it. Options A and B use only one comma and D puts the comma in the wrong place.

questions.question: Convert into a compound sentence: "Having finished his work, he went home."
options: He finished his work and went home.
When he had finished his work, he went home.
After he finished his work, he went home.
As soon as he finished his work, he went home.
questions.explanation: A compound sentence joins independent clauses with a coordinating conjunction such as "and". Options B, C and D use subordinating conjunctions (when, after, as soon as), so they are complex sentences.

questions.question: Change into a simple sentence: "He is rich but he is not happy."
options: In spite of rich, he is not happy.
Because of being rich, he is not happy.
Besides rich, he is not happy.
In spite of being rich, he is not happy.
questions.explanation: A compound sentence with "but" showing contrast becomes simple with "In spite of / Despite + gerund". "In spite of being rich" is correct. Option A lacks "being"; B shows cause, not contrast; C is wrong in meaning.

questions.question: Change into indirect speech: The teacher said to the students, "Be quiet."
options: The teacher asked the students that they be quiet.
The teacher told the students that be quiet.
The teacher ordered the students to be quiet.
The teacher said to the students to be quiet.
questions.explanation: An imperative sentence is reported with a verb such as ordered/told/commanded followed by "to + base verb": "ordered the students to be quiet". The other options use wrong structures.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "Little ___ that the police were watching him."
questions.explanation: After a negative adverb such as "little" placed at the beginning, auxiliary-subject inversion is used: "Little did he know...". The other options have no inversion or wrong verb forms.

questions.question: "What I need most is a long holiday." This sentence is an example of a ___ sentence.
questions.explanation: A pseudo-cleft (wh-cleft) sentence starts with a "what" clause and puts the focus on the information after "is": "What I need most is a long holiday." It is not a question, conditional or passive sentence.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "Unless you work hard, you ___ the examination."
questions.explanation: "Unless" means "if ... not", so the sentence means "If you do not work hard, you will fail." A type-1 conditional takes "will + base verb" in the main clause; "will not fail" reverses the meaning.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "By next June, she ___ here for ten years."
questions.explanation: A time limit "By next June" together with a duration ("for ten years") needs the future perfect continuous: "will have been working". The other tenses do not express a period completed by a future point.

questions.question: In "Ram likes tea and Sita coffee", which word has been omitted from the second part?
questions.explanation: The second part "Sita (likes) coffee" leaves out the repeated verb "likes" to avoid repetition. This omission is called ellipsis (gapping). Subject, conjunction and object are all present.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: "The Nile is ___ longest river in Africa."
questions.explanation: The definite article "the" is used before superlative adjectives like "longest" because only one river is the longest. "A/an" are indefinite and the blank cannot be left empty.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "You ___ respect your elders."
questions.explanation: "Ought" is followed by "to" to express moral duty: "You ought to respect your elders." "Should" and "must" take a bare infinitive, so "should to" and "must to" are wrong.

questions.question: Add the correct question tag: "Nobody called me, ___?"
questions.explanation: "Nobody" is negative in meaning, so the tag is positive; the pronoun "they" is used for "nobody": "did they?".

questions.topic: Finite and non-finite verbs, phrasal verbs
questions.question: The phrasal verb "put off" means ___.
questions.explanation: "Put off" means to postpone or delay, as in "The match was put off due to rain". Dress is "put on", construct is "put up", and praise is not a meaning of this phrasal verb.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "Neither the manager nor the employees ___ present at the meeting."
questions.explanation: With "neither ... nor", the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. "Employees" is plural, so the plural verb "were" is correct.

questions.question: "He is no fool." Which figure of speech is used?
questions.explanation: Litotes is an understatement that affirms something by negating its opposite: "no fool" means "quite clever".

questions.topic: Word formation: root words and affixes
questions.question: Which of the following words is formed with a negative prefix?
questions.explanation: "Irregular" = ir- (not) + regular. In regular, popular and circular, the endings -ar/-lar are part of the root word and no negative prefix is attached.

questions.question: In the sentence "I cannot bear this noise", the word "bear" means ___.
questions.explanation: "Bear" is polysemous (has many related meanings). Here, with "cannot" and "noise", it means to tolerate or endure. Carry and give birth to are other meanings; "an animal" is a noun meaning.

questions.question: Which word is a homophone of "stationary" (not moving)?
questions.explanation: "Stationary" (not moving) and "stationery" (paper, pens etc.) sound the same but differ in spelling and meaning, so they are homophones. The other options have different pronunciation.

questions.question: Choose the correct collocation: "We had ___ rain last night."
questions.explanation: "Heavy rain" is the natural collocation. We do not say "strong rain", "big rain" or "tall rain" in standard English.

questions.question: Choose the verb form of the noun "beauty".
questions.explanation: Adding the suffix -fy changes the noun "beauty" into the verb "beautify" (to make beautiful). "Beautiful" and "beauteous" are adjectives and "beautifully" is an adverb.

questions.question: Complete the lexical bundle: "On the ___ of it, the plan seems sensible."
questions.explanation: "On the face of it" is a fixed lexical bundle meaning "judging by first appearance". The other words do not form this bundle.

questions.question: The idiom "to bury the hatchet" means ___.
questions.explanation: The idiom means to end a quarrel and become friends again. It is the opposite of starting a fight; it has nothing to do with hiding things or cutting trees.

questions.question: "Once in a blue moon" means ___.
questions.explanation: The idiom means very rarely.

questions.question: "Her smile was as bright as sunshine." The figure of speech is ___.
questions.explanation: A direct comparison of two different things using "as ... as" or "like" is a simile. A metaphor would say "Her smile was sunshine"; there is no human quality given to a thing and no contradictory pair of words.

questions.question: "The child is the father of the man." This line is an example of ___.
questions.explanation: A paradox is a seemingly self-contradictory statement that contains a truth; Wordsworth's line means childhood experiences shape the adult.

questions.topic: Word formation: root words and affixes
questions.question: Which is the adjective form of the noun "courage"?
questions.explanation: The suffix -ous forms the adjective "courageous". The other forms are not valid English words.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "The ___ of the old tree gave us shade."
questions.explanation: "Boughs" means large branches of a tree. "Bows" (bends, or ribbons/weapons) is a different word, and the other options are not standard words in this sense.

questions.question: To "smell a rat" means ___.
options: to suspect that something is wrong
questions.explanation: The idiom means to suspect something suspicious or dishonest. Its meaning cannot be guessed from the individual words, which is what idiomatic opacity means.

questions.question: Choose the word that collocates correctly: "Please ___ attention to the lesson."
questions.explanation: "Pay attention" is the standard collocation; give/do/make attention are not used.

questions.question: What does the old man do at dusk?
options: He sells oil to the buyers.
He shouts out the names of sellers.
He lights lamps and places them on the market stone.
He reads books in the market.
questions.explanation: The first three lines say he lights his lamps and sets them on the market stone. He does not sell oil (he asks no price), does not shout, and "reads light" only figuratively.

questions.question: "Reads light as other men read a book" is an example of ___.
questions.explanation: The line compares his way of reading light to other men's reading of a book, using the word "as". This is a simile.

questions.question: The word "patient" in "with patient, wrinkled hands" is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.explanation: "Patient" here describes steady, calm hands that do not hurry, in contrast to the hurrying buyers. Hurried is the opposite; rough and angry do not fit.

questions.question: The poet's attitude towards the old man is ___.
questions.explanation: The poet describes his patience and his gift of light to strangers with warmth, and mentions the people who call him foolish only to show they are wrong. The tone is admiring.

questions.question: Why does the old man leave one lamp burning on the stone at night?
options: He plans to sell it the next day.
He wants strangers to pay him later.
He cares for people even when he is not there.
questions.explanation: The lamp is left "for strangers walking home alone", showing his concern for others. He asks no price and has no business motive.

questions.question: What is the main argument of the editorial?
options: Libraries should be replaced by the internet.
Libraries remain valuable and should be supported, not closed.
Librarians should be paid higher salaries.
questions.explanation: The writer opposes closing libraries and recommends extending hours, local-language books and links with schools. The other options contradict or are not the main point.

questions.question: The writer calls the officials' argument "lazy" because it ___.
options: ignores what libraries give beyond information and the families without internet
questions.explanation: The officials say everything is online, but the passage points out that libraries build reading habits and many families lack connectivity. The argument avoids thinking about these facts, hence "lazy".

questions.question: In the passage, "modest" in "the cost of such a step is modest" means ___.
questions.explanation: Here "modest" describes a cost that is not large. The meanings "shy" and "humble in nature" apply to people, not to cost.

questions.question: "A phone can give a child an answer; a library gives her a habit." This sentence uses ___.
questions.explanation: Two ideas, "answer" and "habit", are set against each other in a balanced structure to show a difference. This is contrast (antithesis).

questions.question: The tone of the editorial is best described as ___.
questions.explanation: The writer is worried about library closures and tries to convince authorities with arguments and suggestions. It is not humorous, neutral or hopeless.

questions.question: According to the passage, bats use echolocation to ___.
options: find objects and prey in the dark
questions.explanation: The passage says bats hunt in darkness using echolocation, which tells them where objects and prey are. The other options are not mentioned.

questions.question: What does the time taken by an echo to return tell the bat?
options: The pitch of its own call
questions.explanation: The passage states that the time taken by the echo tells the bat the distance of the object. Pitch changes show movement, not distance.

questions.question: The word "precise" in the passage is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.explanation: "More precise information" means more exact or accurate information. Rough is its opposite.

questions.question: Arrange the steps in order: (1) The sound bounces back as an echo. (2) The bat sends out a high-pitched sound. (3) The bat's ears catch the echo. (4) The brain compares the echo with the original call.
questions.explanation: First the bat sends out sound (2), it bounces back (1), the ears catch it (3), and the brain compares it with the call (4).

questions.question: Why do scientists study echolocation closely?
options: Because similar principles are used in sonar and aids for the visually impaired
To prove that bats are blind
questions.explanation: The last sentence gives this reason. The passage also says bats are not blind, and nothing is said about training or stopping bats.

questions.question: Which method avoids the use of the mother tongue and teaches meaning through direct association with objects and actions?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सी विधि मातृभाषा का प्रयोग नहीं करती और वस्तुओं व क्रियाओं के सीधे साहचर्य से अर्थ सिखाती है?
questions.explanation: The Direct Method teaches the target language directly, without translation, using objects, pictures and actions. Grammar-Translation and Bilingual methods use the mother tongue.
questions.explanationHi: प्रत्यक्ष विधि में लक्ष्य भाषा सीधे, बिना अनुवाद के, वस्तुओं, चित्रों और क्रियाओं की मदद से सिखाई जाती है। व्याकरण-अनुवाद और द्विभाषिक विधि में मातृभाषा का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: The "Silent Way" of language teaching was developed by ___.
questions.explanation: Caleb Gattegno developed the Silent Way, in which the teacher speaks as little as possible. Krashen is linked with the Monitor Model, Asher with Total Physical Response and Lozanov with Suggestopedia.
questions.questionHi: भाषा शिक्षण की "Silent Way" पद्धति किसने विकसित की?
questions.explanationHi: Silent Way को Caleb Gattegno ने विकसित किया, जिसमें शिक्षक यथासंभव कम बोलता है। Krashen Monitor Model से, Asher Total Physical Response से और Lozanov Suggestopedia से जुड़े हैं।

questions.question: The Total Physical Response (TPR) method of James Asher links language learning with ___.
questions.questionHi: जेम्स एशर की Total Physical Response (TPR) विधि भाषा-अधिगम को ___ से जोड़ती है।
questions.explanation: In TPR the teacher gives commands and learners respond with body movement, linking language with action.
questions.explanationHi: TPR में शिक्षक आदेश देता है और विद्यार्थी शारीरिक क्रिया से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे भाषा क्रिया से जुड़ती है।

questions.question: Language across the curriculum means ___.
questions.questionHi: "Language across the curriculum" का अर्थ है ___।
options: teaching English only in the English period
using and developing language skills in all school subjects
optionsHi: केवल अंग्रेज़ी के पीरियड में अंग्रेज़ी पढ़ाना
केवल कविताओं के माध्यम से व्याकरण पढ़ाना
सभी विषयों में भाषा-कौशलों का प्रयोग और विकास करना
questions.explanation: Every subject teacher uses and builds language (reading, writing, speaking, listening) while teaching content.
questions.explanationHi: हर विषय का शिक्षक विषय पढ़ाते समय पढ़ने, लिखने, बोलने और सुनने के कौशल का प्रयोग व विकास करता है।

questions.question: "i + 1" is associated with which of Krashen's hypotheses?
questions.questionHi: "i + 1" क्रैशेन की किस परिकल्पना से जुड़ा है?
questions.explanation: The Input Hypothesis says learners acquire language when they get comprehensible input slightly above their current level (i + 1).
questions.explanationHi: इनपुट परिकल्पना के अनुसार विद्यार्थी तब भाषा अर्जित करते हैं जब उन्हें अपने वर्तमान स्तर से थोड़ा ऊपर का बोधगम्य इनपुट (i + 1) मिलता है।

questions.question: Which statement about "mistakes" compared with "errors" is correct?
questions.questionHi: "गलती" (mistake) और "त्रुटि" (error) की तुलना में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
options: Mistakes are systematic and reflect incomplete knowledge.
Mistakes are performance slips that the learner can usually self-correct.
Mistakes cannot be corrected by the learner.
Mistakes show the learner's interlanguage rules.
optionsHi: गलतियाँ व्यवस्थित होती हैं और अधूरे ज्ञान को दर्शाती हैं।
गलतियाँ प्रदर्शन की चूक हैं जिन्हें विद्यार्थी प्रायः स्वयं सुधार सकता है।
गलतियों को विद्यार्थी स्वयं नहीं सुधार सकता।
गलतियाँ विद्यार्थी के अंतर्भाषा-नियम दिखाती हैं।
questions.explanation: Following Corder, mistakes are random slips (tiredness, carelessness) that the learner can correct; errors are systematic and show gaps in knowledge.
questions.explanationHi: कॉर्डर के अनुसार गलतियाँ थकान या लापरवाही से हुई आकस्मिक चूकें हैं जिन्हें विद्यार्थी सुधार सकता है; त्रुटियाँ व्यवस्थित होती हैं और ज्ञान की कमी दिखाती हैं।

questions.question: Who introduced the term "interlanguage"?
questions.questionHi: "अंतर्भाषा" (interlanguage) शब्द किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: Larry Selinker (1972) used "interlanguage" for the evolving language system of a second-language learner, lying between the mother tongue and the target language.
questions.explanationHi: लैरी सेलिंकर (1972) ने "अंतर्भाषा" शब्द उस विकसित होती भाषा-व्यवस्था के लिए दिया जो द्वितीय भाषा सीखने वाले की मातृभाषा और लक्ष्य भाषा के बीच होती है।

questions.question: The "Whole Language" approach holds that language is best learnt as ___.
questions.questionHi: "Whole Language" उपागम के अनुसार भाषा ___ के रूप में सबसे अच्छी तरह सीखी जाती है।
options: a meaningful whole in real contexts
optionsHi: वास्तविक संदर्भों में एक सार्थक संपूर्ण इकाई
questions.explanation: The Whole Language approach treats language as an integrated whole learnt through meaningful use (reading, writing, speaking, listening together), not as separate parts.
questions.explanationHi: Whole Language उपागम भाषा को एक संपूर्ण इकाई मानता है, जो सार्थक प्रयोग (पढ़ना, लिखना, बोलना, सुनना साथ-साथ) से सीखी जाती है, अलग-अलग हिस्सों से नहीं।

questions.question: The study of how language is used in context, such as politeness and requests, is called ___.
questions.questionHi: संदर्भ में भाषा के प्रयोग, जैसे शिष्टाचार और अनुरोध, के अध्ययन को ___ कहते हैं।
questions.explanation: Pragmatics deals with meaning in use, depending on speaker, listener and situation. Semantics studies the meaning of words and sentences in themselves.
questions.explanationHi: प्रैग्मैटिक्स वक्ता, श्रोता और परिस्थिति के अनुसार प्रयोग में अर्थ का अध्ययन करता है। सिमैंटिक्स शब्दों और वाक्यों के अपने अर्थ का अध्ययन है।

questions.question: Remedial teaching should begin only after ___.
questions.questionHi: उपचारात्मक शिक्षण ___ के बाद ही शुरू करना चाहिए।
optionsHi: विशिष्ट सीखने की कठिनाई की पहचान (निदान)
questions.explanation: Remedial teaching targets a particular difficulty, so the teacher must first diagnose it through observation and diagnostic tests.
questions.explanationHi: उपचारात्मक शिक्षण किसी विशेष कठिनाई पर केंद्रित होता है, इसलिए शिक्षक को पहले अवलोकन और निदानात्मक परीक्षणों से उसकी पहचान करनी चाहिए।

questions.question: A teacher allows children to use their home languages to understand an English text. This treats the classroom as a ___.
questions.questionHi: एक शिक्षक बच्चों को अंग्रेज़ी पाठ समझने के लिए घर की भाषाओं का प्रयोग करने देता है। इसमें कक्षा को ___ माना जाता है।
questions.explanation: In a diverse classroom, learners' home languages are valuable resources that support understanding of the new language.
questions.explanationHi: विविध कक्षा में बच्चों की घर की भाषाएँ नई भाषा समझने में सहायक मूल्यवान संसाधन होती हैं।

questions.question: Which language skill is acquired first in natural language development?
questions.questionHi: स्वाभाविक भाषा-विकास में कौन-सा भाषा-कौशल सबसे पहले अर्जित होता है?
questions.explanation: A child first hears the language around him, then speaks, and later learns reading and writing. So listening comes first.
questions.explanationHi: बच्चा पहले अपने आसपास की भाषा सुनता है, फिर बोलता है और बाद में पढ़ना-लिखना सीखता है। इसलिए सुनना सबसे पहले आता है।

questions.question: A functional approach to teaching grammar means teaching grammar ___.
questions.questionHi: व्याकरण शिक्षण के प्रकार्यात्मक (functional) उपागम का अर्थ है व्याकरण को ___ सिखाना।
options: as isolated rules to be memorised
in context, through its use in communication
optionsHi: अलग-अलग नियमों के रूप में रटवाकर
संदर्भ में, संप्रेषण में उसके प्रयोग द्वारा
questions.explanation: Modern views prefer teaching grammar in meaningful contexts so learners see how forms express ideas, rather than as memorised rules.
questions.explanationHi: आधुनिक दृष्टिकोण व्याकरण को सार्थक संदर्भों में सिखाने पर बल देता है ताकि विद्यार्थी देखें कि रूप विचारों को कैसे व्यक्त करते हैं, केवल रटे नियम नहीं।

questions.question: According to Krashen, "acquisition" of language is ___.
questions.questionHi: क्रैशेन के अनुसार भाषा का "अर्जन" (acquisition) ___ है।
options: a subconscious process, like a child picking up the mother tongue
optionsHi: व्याकरण के नियमों का सचेत अध्ययन
एक अवचेतन प्रक्रिया, जैसे बच्चा मातृभाषा सीख लेता है
questions.explanation: Krashen distinguishes subconscious acquisition from conscious learning. Acquisition happens naturally through meaningful interaction.
questions.explanationHi: क्रैशेन अवचेतन अर्जन और सचेत अधिगम में अंतर करते हैं। अर्जन सार्थक अंतःक्रिया से स्वाभाविक रूप से होता है।

questions.question: In a language classroom, Vygotsky's Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) refers to ___.
questions.questionHi: भाषा कक्षा में वाइगोत्स्की का निकटवर्ती विकास क्षेत्र (ZPD) ___ को कहते हैं।
options: the physical space where learners sit
the maximum marks a learner can score
the gap between what a learner can do alone and with help
optionsHi: वह भौतिक स्थान जहाँ विद्यार्थी बैठते हैं
विद्यार्थी द्वारा प्राप्त किए जा सकने वाले अधिकतम अंक
जो विद्यार्थी अकेले कर सकता है और सहायता से कर सकता है, उसके बीच का अंतर
questions.explanation: ZPD is the distance between independent performance and performance with guidance from a teacher or peer; teaching should work in this zone.
questions.explanationHi: ZPD स्वतंत्र प्रदर्शन और शिक्षक या साथी की सहायता से प्रदर्शन के बीच की दूरी है; शिक्षण इसी क्षेत्र में होना चाहिए।

questions.question: Which level of Kohlberg's moral development is marked by acting on universal ethical principles?
questions.questionHi: कोहलबर्ग के नैतिक विकास का कौन-सा स्तर सार्वभौमिक नैतिक सिद्धांतों पर आधारित आचरण से पहचाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: At the post-conventional level, a person follows self-chosen universal principles such as justice and human rights. The conventional level follows social rules and the pre-conventional level focuses on punishment and reward.
questions.explanationHi: उत्तर-परंपरागत स्तर पर व्यक्ति न्याय और मानव अधिकार जैसे स्वयं चुने सार्वभौमिक सिद्धांतों का पालन करता है। परंपरागत स्तर में सामाजिक नियमों का और पूर्व-परंपरागत स्तर में दंड-पुरस्कार का ध्यान रहता है।

questions.question: Thorndike's trial-and-error experiments used a hungry ___ in a puzzle box.
questions.questionHi: थॉर्नडाइक के प्रयास-और-त्रुटि प्रयोग में puzzle box में एक भूखी ___ को रखा गया था।
questions.explanation: Thorndike placed a hungry cat in a puzzle box; rats were Skinner's subjects (Skinner box) and dogs Pavlov's.
questions.explanationHi: थॉर्नडाइक ने भूखी बिल्ली को puzzle box में रखा; चूहे स्किनर के और कुत्ता पावलोव के प्रयोगों में थे।

questions.question: The Wechsler scales (WISC and WAIS) are tests used to measure ___.
questions.questionHi: वेक्सलर स्केल (WISC और WAIS) ___ मापने के परीक्षण हैं।
questions.explanation: David Wechsler developed the WISC (children) and WAIS (adults) scales to measure intelligence.
questions.explanationHi: डेविड वेक्सलर ने बच्चों के लिए WISC और वयस्कों के लिए WAIS बुद्धि-मापन हेतु बनाए।

questions.question: The terms "introvert" and "extrovert" for personality types were popularised by ___.
questions.questionHi: व्यक्तित्व के प्रकारों के लिए "अंतर्मुखी" (introvert) और "बहिर्मुखी" (extrovert) शब्द ___ ने लोकप्रिय बनाए।
questions.explanation: Carl Jung classified people into introverts and extroverts.
questions.explanationHi: कार्ल युंग ने व्यक्तियों को अंतर्मुखी और बहिर्मुखी में वर्गीकृत किया।

questions.question: Bruner described three modes of representation: enactive, iconic and ___.
questions.questionHi: ब्रूनर ने निरूपण के तीन तरीके बताए: enactive, iconic और ___।
questions.explanation: Bruner's modes are enactive (action), iconic (images) and symbolic (language/symbols).
questions.explanationHi: ब्रूनर के तरीके हैं enactive (क्रिया), iconic (चित्र/प्रतिमा) और symbolic (भाषा/प्रतीक)।

questions.question: Braille is a system of reading and writing mainly used by children with ___.
questions.questionHi: ब्रेल (Braille) पढ़ने-लिखने की वह प्रणाली है जो मुख्यतः ___ वाले बच्चे प्रयोग करते हैं।
questions.explanation: Braille is a tactile system of raised dots used by persons who are blind or have low vision.
questions.explanationHi: ब्रेल उभरे हुए बिंदुओं की स्पर्श-आधारित प्रणाली है, जिसे नेत्रहीन या अल्प-दृष्टि वाले व्यक्ति प्रयोग करते हैं।

questions.question: When a learner evaluates his or her own work against given criteria, it is called ___.
questions.questionHi: जब विद्यार्थी दिए गए मानदंडों के आधार पर अपने ही कार्य का मूल्यांकन करता है, तो उसे ___ कहते हैं।
questions.explanation: Self-assessment is learners judging their own work; peer assessment is by classmates and teacher assessment by the teacher.
questions.explanationHi: स्व-मूल्यांकन में विद्यार्थी अपने कार्य को स्वयं परखता है; सहपाठी मूल्यांकन साथी करते हैं और शिक्षक मूल्यांकन शिक्षक।

questions.question: If a test gives almost the same scores when given again to the same students, the test is ___.
questions.questionHi: यदि कोई परीक्षण उन्हीं विद्यार्थियों को दोबारा देने पर लगभग समान अंक देता है, तो वह परीक्षण ___ है।
questions.explanation: Consistency of results is reliability. Validity is measuring what is intended, objectivity is freedom from scorer bias and usability is practicality.
questions.explanationHi: परिणामों की संगति विश्वसनीयता है। वैधता का अर्थ है जो मापना है उसे मापना, वस्तुनिष्ठता अंकन में पक्षपात का अभाव है और व्यावहारिकता उपयोग में सरलता है।

questions.question: A list of behaviours or skills marked as present or absent while observing a learner is called a ___.
questions.questionHi: किसी विद्यार्थी का अवलोकन करते समय उपस्थित या अनुपस्थित व्यवहारों/कौशलों की जो सूची अंकित की जाती है, उसे ___ कहते हैं।
questions.explanation: A checklist records whether specific behaviours or skills are observed; the others are not assessment tools.
questions.explanationHi: Checklist में देखा जाता है कि कोई व्यवहार या कौशल मौजूद है या नहीं; अन्य विकल्प मूल्यांकन के उपकरण नहीं हैं।

questions.question: "Assessment for learning" refers to ___ assessment.
questions.questionHi: "Assessment for learning" से तात्पर्य ___ मूल्यांकन से है।
questions.explanation: Assessment for learning is ongoing, formative assessment used to improve teaching and learning, whereas summative is "assessment of learning".
questions.explanationHi: Assessment for learning सतत रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन है जो शिक्षण-अधिगम सुधारने में काम आता है, जबकि योगात्मक "assessment of learning" है।

questions.question: The report "Learning Without Burden" (1993) was submitted under the chairmanship of ___.
questions.questionHi: "Learning Without Burden" (1993) रिपोर्ट ___ की अध्यक्षता में प्रस्तुत हुई।
questions.explanation: The 1993 report "Learning Without Burden" was prepared by a national advisory committee chaired by Prof. Yash Pal; Kothari, Radhakrishnan and Mudaliar chaired other commissions.
questions.explanationHi: 1993 की "Learning Without Burden" रिपोर्ट प्रो. यशपाल की अध्यक्षता वाली राष्ट्रीय सलाहकार समिति ने तैयार की; कोठारी, राधाकृष्णन और मुदलियार अन्य आयोगों के अध्यक्ष थे।

questions.question: Which is the first step in planning a lesson?
questions.questionHi: पाठ की योजना बनाने का पहला चरण कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Objectives decide the content, method, aids and evaluation, so they come first in lesson planning.
questions.explanationHi: उद्देश्य ही विषय-वस्तु, विधि, सामग्री और मूल्यांकन तय करते हैं, इसलिए पाठ-योजना में वे सबसे पहले आते हैं।

questions.question: Classroom dialogue mainly helps students to ___.
questions.questionHi: कक्षा-संवाद मुख्य रूप से विद्यार्थियों को ___ में मदद करता है।
options: develop thinking and expression through discussion
optionsHi: चर्चा द्वारा सोचने और अभिव्यक्ति की क्षमता विकसित करने
questions.explanation: Dialogue lets students question, explain and exchange ideas, building understanding and communication skills.
questions.explanationHi: संवाद से विद्यार्थी प्रश्न पूछते, समझाते और विचार बाँटते हैं, जिससे समझ और संप्रेषण-कौशल बढ़ता है।

questions.question: In constructivism, the learner is seen as ___.
questions.questionHi: रचनावाद में विद्यार्थी को ___ माना जाता है।
options: an empty vessel to be filled
a follower of fixed habits only
questions.explanation: Constructivism holds that learners build knowledge from their own experiences and interactions; they are not passive receivers.
questions.explanationHi: रचनावाद के अनुसार विद्यार्थी अपने अनुभवों और अंतःक्रियाओं से ज्ञान का निर्माण करते हैं; वे निष्क्रिय ग्राहक नहीं होते।

questions.question: A gender-sensitive teacher ___.
questions.questionHi: लिंग-संवेदनशील शिक्षक ___।
options: gives equal opportunities to girls and boys
calls on only boys to answer
optionsHi: रूढ़ियों के अनुसार कार्य बाँटता है
लड़कियों और लड़कों को समान अवसर देता है
उत्तर के लिए केवल लड़कों को बुलाता है
लड़कियों से विज्ञान से दूर रहने की अपेक्षा करता है
questions.explanation: A gender-sensitive teacher avoids stereotypes and gives equal opportunity and respect to all learners.
questions.explanationHi: लिंग-संवेदनशील शिक्षक रूढ़ियों से बचता है और सभी विद्यार्थियों को समान अवसर व सम्मान देता है।

questions.question: "जिस स्त्री का पति मर गया हो" — के लिए एक शब्द है —
questions.explanation: पति की मृत्यु हो जाने पर स्त्री को "विधवा" कहते हैं; "सधवा" जिसका पति जीवित हो।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से तद्भव शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: "आग" संस्कृत के "अग्नि" से बना है, इसलिए तद्भव है। अग्नि, सूर्य और पुष्प तत्सम शब्द हैं।

questions.question: "सागर" का पर्यायवाची शब्द नहीं है —
questions.explanation: समुद्र, जलधि और रत्नाकर "सागर" के पर्यायवाची हैं। "सरिता" का अर्थ नदी है।

questions.question: "नीलकमल" में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: "नीलकमल" = नीला है जो कमल। इसमें विशेषण और विशेष्य का संबंध है, इसलिए यह कर्मधारय समास है।

questions.question: "सज्जन" का सही संधि-विच्छेद है —
questions.explanation: सत् + जन = सज्जन (व्यंजन संधि: त् + ज = ज्ज)।

questions.question: Choose the correct article: "He is ___ honest man."
questions.explanation: The word "honest" begins with a vowel sound (the h is silent), so "an" is used.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "expand".
questions.explanation: "Expand" means to become larger; its opposite is "contract", meaning to become smaller.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "generous".
questions.explanation: "Generous" means willing to give; its opposite is "miserly" (unwilling to spend or give). Kind and liberal are similar in meaning.

questions.question: One word for "a person who can speak two languages":
questions.explanation: A "bilingual" person speaks two languages. A polyglot knows many languages, a linguist studies language and an orator gives speeches.

questions.question: Change into passive voice: "Someone has stolen my purse."
questions.explanation: The present perfect "has stolen" becomes "has been stolen" in the passive. The other options change the tense.

questions.question: Find the next number: 5, 10, 20, 40, 80, ?
questions.explanation: Each term is double the previous one, so the next term is 80 × 2 = 160.
questions.explanationHi: प्रत्येक पद पिछले पद का दुगुना है, इसलिए अगला पद 80 × 2 = 160 है।

questions.question: If CAT is coded as DBU, how is DOG coded in the same way?
questions.questionHi: यदि CAT को DBU लिखा जाता है, तो उसी प्रकार DOG को कैसे लिखेंगे?
questions.explanation: Each letter is moved one place forward: D to E, O to P, G to H, so DOG becomes EPH.
questions.explanationHi: प्रत्येक अक्षर एक स्थान आगे बढ़ाया गया है: D से E, O से P, G से H, इसलिए DOG = EPH।

questions.question: A man is facing west. He turns 90° clockwise, then 180° anticlockwise, and then 90° clockwise. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: Facing West, 90° clockwise gives North; 180° anticlockwise gives South; 90° clockwise gives West. So he faces West.
questions.questionHi: एक व्यक्ति पश्चिम की ओर मुँह करके खड़ा है। वह 90° दक्षिणावर्त (clockwise) मुड़ता है, फिर 180° वामावर्त (anticlockwise), और फिर 90° दक्षिणावर्त। अब वह किस दिशा में देख रहा है?
questions.explanationHi: पश्चिम की ओर मुँह; 90° clockwise → उत्तर; 180° anticlockwise → दक्षिण; 90° clockwise → पश्चिम। इसलिए वह पश्चिम की ओर देख रहा है।

questions.question: Facing east, Ram turns right and then turns right again. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.questionHi: पूर्व की ओर मुँह करके राम दाएँ मुड़ता है और फिर दोबारा दाएँ मुड़ता है। अब उसका मुँह किस दिशा में है?
questions.explanation: East → right turn → South → right turn → West.
questions.explanationHi: पूर्व → दाएँ मुड़ने पर दक्षिण → फिर दाएँ मुड़ने पर पश्चिम।

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Apple, Potato, Mango, Banana
questions.questionHi: विषम चुनिए: सेब, आलू, आम, केला
questions.explanation: Apple, mango and banana are fruits, while potato is a vegetable.
questions.explanationHi: सेब, आम और केला फल हैं, जबकि आलू सब्ज़ी है।

questions.question: What is the full form of USB?
questions.questionHi: USB का पूरा नाम क्या है?
questions.explanation: USB stands for Universal Serial Bus, a standard for connecting peripherals.
questions.explanationHi: USB का पूरा नाम Universal Serial Bus है, जो उपकरणों को जोड़ने का मानक है।

questions.question: Google Drive is an example of ___ storage.
questions.questionHi: Google Drive ___ संग्रहण (storage) का उदाहरण है।
questions.explanation: Google Drive stores files on internet servers, i.e. cloud storage.
questions.explanationHi: Google Drive फ़ाइलें इंटरनेट सर्वरों पर रखता है, अर्थात यह क्लाउड स्टोरेज है।

questions.question: Which file extension is used by MS PowerPoint 2007 and later versions by default?
questions.questionHi: MS PowerPoint 2007 और बाद के संस्करणों में डिफ़ॉल्ट फ़ाइल एक्सटेंशन कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: PowerPoint files use .pptx; .docx is Word, .xlsx is Excel and .txt is plain text.
questions.explanationHi: PowerPoint फ़ाइलें .pptx होती हैं; .docx Word की, .xlsx Excel की और .txt सादे पाठ की होती है।

questions.question: Which key starts a slide show from the first slide in MS PowerPoint?
questions.questionHi: MS PowerPoint में पहली स्लाइड से स्लाइड-शो शुरू करने की कुंजी कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: F5 starts the slide show from the beginning; F1 is Help.
questions.explanationHi: F5 स्लाइड-शो को शुरू से चलाता है; F1 Help खोलता है।

questions.question: What is the full form of URL?
questions.questionHi: URL का पूरा नाम क्या है?
questions.explanation: URL stands for Uniform Resource Locator, the address of a web resource.
questions.explanationHi: URL का पूरा नाम Uniform Resource Locator है; यह वेब संसाधन का पता होता है।

questions.question: Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution by which Amendment?
questions.questionHi: भारतीय संविधान में मौलिक कर्तव्य किस संशोधन द्वारा जोड़े गए?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment (1976) added Part IV-A with Fundamental Duties. The 24th concerns amendment of Fundamental Rights, the 44th restored many rights curtailed earlier and the 52nd deals with anti-defection.
questions.explanationHi: 42वें संशोधन (1976) ने भाग IV-A में मौलिक कर्तव्य जोड़े। 24वाँ संशोधन मौलिक अधिकारों के संशोधन से, 44वाँ पूर्व में घटाए गए अधिकारों की बहाली से और 52वाँ दल-बदल कानून से संबंधित है।

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in the year ___.
questions.questionHi: जलियाँवाला बाग हत्याकांड ___ में हुआ था।
questions.explanation: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre at Amritsar took place on 13 April 1919.
questions.explanationHi: अमृतसर का जलियाँवाला बाग हत्याकांड 13 अप्रैल 1919 को हुआ था।

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced in the human skin when it is exposed to sunlight?
questions.questionHi: धूप के संपर्क में आने पर मानव त्वचा में कौन-सा विटामिन बनता है?
questions.explanation: Sunlight helps the skin synthesise Vitamin D. Vitamin C comes from food such as citrus fruits, and A and K are mainly obtained from diet.
questions.explanationHi: सूर्य के प्रकाश से त्वचा विटामिन D बनाती है। विटामिन C खट्टे फलों जैसे भोजन से मिलता है तथा A और K मुख्यतः आहार से मिलते हैं।

questions.question: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains the list of recognised languages?
questions.questionHi: भारतीय संविधान की कौन-सी अनुसूची में मान्यता प्राप्त भाषाओं की सूची है?
questions.explanation: The Eighth Schedule lists the recognised languages of India. The Tenth Schedule deals with anti-defection.
questions.explanationHi: आठवीं अनुसूची में भारत की मान्यता प्राप्त भाषाएँ सूचीबद्ध हैं। दसवीं अनुसूची दल-बदल से संबंधित है।

questions.question: Pandavani, a folk performing art that narrates Mahabharata stories, is associated with which state?
questions.questionHi: पंडवानी, जो महाभारत की कथाओं का लोक-गायन है, किस राज्य से संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: Pandavani is a well-known folk art of Chhattisgarh, made famous by Teejan Bai. The other states have different folk traditions.
questions.explanationHi: पंडवानी छत्तीसगढ़ की प्रसिद्ध लोक-कला है, जिसे तीजन बाई ने प्रसिद्ध किया। अन्य राज्यों की लोक-परंपराएँ अलग हैं।
